c: The resolution SLA attaches as soon as the incident has a priority. It counts from when the incident was created.
say: The resolution SLA attaches as soon as the incident has a priority, and it counts from when the incident was created.

c: The clock stops while the incident is On Hold - Awaiting Caller, and from the moment you resolve it. Waiting for a change, a problem or a vendor doesn't stop it.
say: The clock pauses while you wait for the caller, and from the moment you resolve the incident. Waiting for a change, a problem or a vendor does not pause it.

c: At 50% the assignee gets a warning email, and so does the person who supports the incident's configuration item.
say: At half the time, the assignee gets a warning email, and so does the person who supports the configuration item.

c: At 75% the assignee and the assignee's manager are warned.
say: At three quarters, the assignee and their manager are warned.

c: At the deadline both get "… has breached". The clock keeps running until the incident closes.
say: At the deadline, both get a breach email. The clock keeps running until the incident closes.

c: The SLA completes at Closed. Since it pauses at Resolved, resolving in time meets it, unless the caller reopens.
say: The SLA completes when the incident closes. Because it pauses at resolved, resolving in time meets it, unless the caller reopens.

c: In the workspace, open Record Information in the side panel: SLAs and timings shows the Response SLA and Resolution SLA timers; View all SLAs lists the rest.
say: In the workspace, open record information in the side panel. Under SLAs and timings you see the response and resolution timers, and view all SLAs lists the others.
